name: kind:action
description: An actionable outcome; the issue is the shared record.

name: Project
description: A parent outcome whose next actions are linked issues.

name: Inbox
description: Captured, not yet clarified and organised.

name: 1-Now
description: Chosen attention horizon: do now.

name: 2-Next
description: Chosen attention horizon: plan next.

name: 3-Soon
description: Chosen attention horizon: review soon.

name: 4-Later
description: Chosen attention horizon: review later.

name: 5-Someday
description: Chosen attention horizon: someday or maybe.

name: 6-Waiting
description: Waiting on a named person, dependency, or decision; not a horizon.

name: state:ready
description: Available for selection, not permission to execute.

name: state:running
description: An explicitly assigned executor is actively working.

name: state:review
description: Evidence or a proposal is ready for a human decision.

name: state:failed
description: Execution stopped unsuccessfully; a next step is needed.

name: automation:needs-fix
description: Invalid action metadata; see the issue's validation comment.

name: view:capture
description: Computed Capture view. Do not edit this label manually.

name: view:do-now
description: Computed Now, today, overdue, or Inbox view.

name: view:plan-next
description: Computed Next or tomorrow view, excluding 1-Now.

name: view:review-soon
description: Computed Soon or days 2-6 view, excluding Now and Next.

name: view:review-later
description: Computed Later or days 7-29 view, excluding Now, Next, and Soon.

name: view:someday
description: Computed Someday or undated view, excluding earlier horizons and Waiting.

name: view:waiting
description: Computed 6-Waiting view.

name: view:projects
description: Computed parent-project view.
